name: Abyss
source:
I couldn’t see, couldn’t hear, couldn’t move, couldn’t feel.


What is this place? How did I get here, and why?


How can I answer these questions if I don’t remember anything?


The only memory I have is...

[From [url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/abyss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我看不到，听不到，动不了，感觉不到。


这是什么地方？我是怎么到这里的，为什么？


如果我什么都不记得了，我该如何回答这些问题呢？


我唯一的记忆是…

[来自[url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/abyss]itch.io[/url]]
